target: Sign of actual MUSA retail margin minus unchanged production forecast; not year-over-year margin direction
cutoff: MUSA quarter end; donor publication strictly before cutoff and positive fiscal overlap
signals: Sign of mean latest four published same-era MUSA residuals, at least four required
neutral: Absolute signal <=1e-10 abstains; no forced direction for missing evidence
comparators: Majority sign of earlier published same-era MUSA residuals, at least four required
groups: All eligible production-test quarters and modern 2021 onward; large original production error >=5c is a retrospective scoring subgroup, never a signal selector
metrics: Call coverage, correct/total, above/below recalls, balanced accuracy, same-row naive comparators, Wilson descriptive interval, drop-one-quarter accuracy range
selection: No threshold tuning, no fitting to selected large misses, no automatic forecast adjustment or probability calibration
